title: How to write a cancellation policy for a salon
summary: Paste your actual rules into ChatGPT and get a clear salon cancellation policy, plus a short version for texts. Check every fee before you publish it.

tests.prompt:
You help a salon owner write a cancellation policy. Draft only. Do not publish it.

Fill in these details. If a line is blank, write UNKNOWN and do not guess.

Salon name: [SALON NAME]
How much notice you need: [NOTICE]
What happens if they cancel late: [LATE CANCEL FEE]
What happens if they no-show: [NO SHOW FEE]
How to cancel or reschedule: [HOW TO CANCEL]
Exceptions you actually allow: [EXCEPTIONS]
Where this policy will be shown: [WHERE USED]
Your name: [YOUR NAME]

Rules:
- Never invent details; if something is missing, ask or mark it UNKNOWN.
- Do not invent a fee, a notice window, or an exception.
- Do not use legal threats or credit-card jargon you did not provide.
- Keep the policy short, fair, and easy to read before someone books.
- No scolding language. State the rule, the fee if there is one, and how to cancel.
- If a fee is blank, mark it UNKNOWN. Do not write "a fee may apply."

Output format:
Return these headings only:
Policy title
The rule (80 words or fewer)
Late cancel
No-show
How to cancel
Exceptions
Short version for a confirmation text (40 words or fewer)
Facts used
Unknown

setup.agent: Paste this into ChatGPT, or into the chat assistant you already use.
steps: Write the salon name, how much notice you need, the late-cancel fee, the no-show fee, how clients should cancel, and any exceptions you truly allow.
Add where you will show the policy (website, booking page, confirmation text) and your name.
Open ChatGPT, paste the ChatGPT prompt, and replace every [BRACKET]. Type UNKNOWN if you have not decided on a fee.
Check every fee and the notice window. Delete any charge or exception you do not actually use.
Post the policy on your booking page or website, and paste the short version into your confirmation texts yourself.
setup.approvalStep: You check the notice window and the fees against what you actually charge, then you publish the policy yourself.
failureModes: The draft invents a fee or a longer notice window than you use. Put your real rule back in.
The exceptions are narrower or broader than you meant. Keep only the exceptions you will honor.
The short text version adds a fee that is not in the full policy. Make them match.
The wording sounds like a threat. Keep it calm and clear before you post it.

faq.q: Do I have to charge a fee?
faq.a: No. If you only need notice and you do not charge, leave the fee lines blank and say so in your notes. Do not let the draft invent a charge.
Post it on your booking page and include the short version in confirmation texts, so people see it before the appointment, not after a missed visit.

faq.q: Can I take a card to hold the appointment?
faq.a: Only if that is already your practice and you add it to the details. This prompt will not invent a card-on-file rule.

job: Paste your real cancel rules and get a clear salon cancellation policy, plus a short text version.
who: Salon owners who need a plain cancellation and no-show policy they can post and include in appointment confirmations.

example.scenario: A salon wants a 24-hour cancellation policy with a half-service late-cancel fee and a full-service no-show fee.
example.input:
Salon name: Willow Salon
How much notice you need: 24 hours
What happens if they cancel late: 50 percent of the service price
What happens if they no-show: The full service price
How to cancel or reschedule: Call or text the salon at 555-0155
Exceptions you actually allow: Illness and severe weather, if they contact us as soon as they can
Where this policy will be shown: Booking page and confirmation texts
Your name: Jordan, owner
example.output:
Policy title: Willow Salon cancellation policy

The rule: Please give us 24 hours notice if you need to cancel or move an appointment. That notice lets us offer the time to someone else.

Late cancel: If you cancel with less than 24 hours notice, we charge 50 percent of the service price.

No-show: If you miss the appointment without notice, we charge the full service price.

How to cancel: Call or text Willow Salon at 555-0155.

Exceptions: If you are ill or weather makes travel unsafe, contact us as soon as you can and we will work with you.

Short version for a confirmation text: Please give 24 hours notice to cancel or reschedule. Late cancels are 50 percent of the service, and a no-show is the full service price. Call or text 555-0155.

Facts used: Willow Salon, 24 hours, 50 percent, full service, 555-0155, illness and severe weather.
Unknown: none.
example.notes: Made-up salon rules, only to show a clear policy and a short text version.
